findings.message: Outside this rubric (display only): the a3 citation quotes for Liṅga Purāṇa 1.3.3 and 1.3.4 copy GRETIL markup from linga-purana-1-3.md, a '%' half-verse separator and a double space ('gandhavarṇarasairyuktaṃ  % śabdasparśādilakṣaṇam', 'vigraho jagatāṃ liṅgam  % aliṅgād abhavatsvayam'). The words match the excerpt, but if quotes are shown on the site this markup will show too. A human should decide whether to remove it.
